properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 818217

Nearest City: Corpus Christi, TX
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: HYDRAULIC OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: JAVELER CONSTRUCTION CO
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 3 gallons
//////////////WEB REPORT//////////// AT APPOXIMATELY 17:30 ON 11-11-2006 A HYDRAULIC LINE ON A GALLON 15 TON MOBILE CRANE FAILED. THE CRANE WAS BEING OPERATED BY JAVELER CONSTRUCTION CO. DURING A DREDGING OPERATION. THE CRANE WAS ON A 30' X 60' FLEXIFLOAT MODULAR BARGE. THE HOSE THAT FAILED WAS LOCATED AT THE REAR OF THE CRANE BY THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT NEAR THE MIDPOINT OF THE BARGE. AS SOON AS THE FAILED HOSE WAS DISCOVERED, THE CREW DISCONTINUED OPERATIONS AND BEGAN ABSORBING THE HYDRAULIC OIL WITH ENBIRONMENTAL ABSORBENT PADS. THEY WORKED ON THE CLEAN-UP UNTIL DARK. THE FOLLOWING MORNING THE CREW NOTICED A SLIGHT SHEEN ON THE SURFACE OF THE WATER. THE CREW AGAIN WORKED FROM 07:00 TO 10:00 TO MORNING THE CREW NOTICED A SLIGHT SHEEN ON THE SURFACE OF THE WATER. THE CREW AGAIN WORKED FROM 07:00 TO 10:00 TO REMOVE ANY HYDRAULIC OIL FROM THE DECK AND BETWEEN THE MODULES OF THE BARGE. UPON COMPLETION, THE CREW WAS SATISFIED THAT THE PROBLEM HAD BEEN REMEDIATED TO THE BEST OF THEIR ABILITY.

properties.content:
Report Details

Incident Time: 2020-11-24 12:43:00
Nearest City: Walnut Creek, CA
Location: SOUTH BROADWAY
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: GASOLINE: AUTOMOTIVE (UNLEADED)
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: KINDER MORGAN ENERGY
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 37.888823, -122.053026 (Approximated from route)
Report DescriptionCALLER IS REPORTING THE RELEASE OF AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF GASOLINE FROM A DISTRIBUTION PIPELINE. THE RELEASED MATERIAL WENT ONTO THE GROUND AND INTO WALNUT CREEK. THE CAUSE OF THE RELEASE IS DUE TO EQUIPMENT FAILURE. CALLER STATED VERBATIM "KINDER MORGAN HAS SUBMITTED NOTIFICATIONS ON TWO OCCASIONS FOR 2 RELEASE AREAS ASSUMED TO BE UNRELATED. NRC REPORT #1292974 11/24/20 @2155. NRC REPORT# 1293391 12/2/20 @1200NOON. BASED ON RECENT FIELD INSTRUMENTATION READINGS OF THE GRAVEL PACKING AROUND THE CITY OF WALNUT CREEKS 66 INCH SANITARY SEWER LINE THERE IS POTENTIAL THAT THE TWO LOCATIONS REPORTED ARE RELATED TO A SINGLE POTENTIAL RELEASE OF PETROLEUM PRODUCTS. NRC REPORT #1292974, THE ASSUMPTION IS THAT THIS GRAVEL PACKING AROUND THE SANITARY SEWER MAY HAVE BEEN A PATHWAY FOR MATERIALS RELEASED FROM THE ORIGINAL LOCATION NEAR SOUTH BROADWAY TO THE CURRENT AREA OF INTEREST IDENTIFIED AS THE IRON HORSE TRAIL LOCATION IN NRC REPORT# 1293391.
